Package org.applecommander.archive.shrinkit

package org.applecommander.archive.shrinkit

ShrinkIt archive format support.

ShrinkIt is a compression archive format for Apple II files, commonly used for distributing software and disk images. Archives are typically stored with the .shk or .sdk file extensions and are identified by a magic byte sequence (NuFile ID) at the beginning of the file.

Each ShrinkIt archive contains a master header block with archive-level metadata (creation/modification timestamps, version, total record count, and a CRC-16 integrity checksum), followed by per-file header blocks. Each archived file stores full ProDOS metadata including file name, type, auxiliary type, access mode, storage type, and creation and modification timestamps.

File content is stored as compressed threads, with separate support for both the data fork and the resource fork. Each thread record specifies a compression format (thread format), a kind indicator (e.g. disk image), a compressed size, and a CRC-16 checksum for integrity verification. The archive preserves the original uncompressed file size alongside the compressed data, enabling display of compression ratios.

This package provides a FileStore implementation that parses ShrinkIt archives and exposes their contents through the standard AppleCommander file store API, enabling browsing, metadata inspection, and extraction of archived files with full ProDOS attributes and resource fork support.
